title: Handoff Maestro — Deploy Briefing and Coverage Grid (Oct 2025) - WIP
content:
Purpose:
  Quick, actionable deploy briefing and nightly coverage grid for the Oct 24–26 rollout window. Focus: keep the change low-risk but allow rapid rollback if latency/quality regressions appear. This is a working document (notes-to-self style) — please add live edits during the dry run.

Audience:
  Release engineers, SRE oncall, product eng leads, support duty.

High-level summary:
  - Release wave: gradual regional ramp, two-step model variant swap for hosted-api route (/v1/generate).
  - Goal: <50ms P50 change, P95 within service SLO; unit-cost within 8% of baseline.
  - Canary cadence: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%, ~30m observe windows.

Deployment calendar (local times):
  2025-10-24 09:00 PT — Preflight sync (15m) — leads only (Priya / Daniel / Elena)
  2025-10-24 09:20 PT — Dry-run on staging (smoke + perf) — ops runbook checklist
  2025-10-24 10:00 PT — Canary 1 (2%) — start telemetry sampling + tracer tags
  2025-10-24 10:30 PT — Canary 2 (10%) — evaluate cost/latency regressions
  2025-10-24 11:15 PT — Canary 3 (30%) — monitor routing fallbacks
  2025-10-24 12:00 PT — Full rollout (100%) if green or rollback plan B if triggers

Coverage grid (roles / shifts) — Oct 24 day-of:
  - Deploy Conductor (Priya) — coord, escalate decisions, approves roll/freeze
  - Oncall SRE (Marcus) — telemetry, infra alarms, throttle controls, rollback toggle
  - Runtime Engineer (Daniel) — model routing, kernel selection checks, quick hotfix PRs
  - Product Eng (Elena) — user-impact triage, QA escalations, acceptance sign-off
  - Support Liaison (Sofia) — customer comms, incident banner drafts, status page updates

Preflight checklist (must pass before any canary):
  - [ ] Smoke tests pass on staging (text gen basic flows, embeddings, function-calls)
  - [ ] Latency baseline snapshot captured (last-7d) and uploaded to artifacts (see link)
  - [ ] Traffic cut/route config pushed to canary cluster (dry-run net policy applied)
  - [ ] KV cache primed with representative prefixes for long-tail prompts
  - [ ] Canary tokens set and sampling flags enabled in Console (tag: maestro-oct25)
  - [ ] Rollback artifact tested: deploy previous model variant + config restore script
  - [ ] Pagerflow and oncall rotation confirmed for the window (Marcus assigned)

Day-of quick commands (ops cheats):
  - Start canary: tools/deploy --route hosted-api --variant v2 --percent 2 --tag maestro-oct25
  - Increase: tools/deploy --increase 10 --observe 30m
  - Emergency rollback: tools/deploy --force-variant v1 --immediate && postmortem-flag set
  - Throttle traffic by region: tools/routing --region eu-west1 --set 0.01

Observability signals (primary):
  - Latency: P50 / P95 for generate & chat endpoints (30s refresh)
  - Error rate: 5xx and model fallback invocations (30s)
  - Cost signal: tokens/sec and GPU utilisation (5m)
  - Quality guardrails: eval-set pass rate (sampled 1/500 requests) + hallucination spike detector

Rollback / degrade triggers (hard triggers -> immediate rollback):
  - P95 latency increases > 2x baseline for >10m
  - Error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained >10m
  - Eval-set failure rate increases > 5% absolute
  - Unrecoverable OOMs or driver failures on >=2 nodes

Soft-fail responses (investigate, maybe pause, not immediate rollback):
  - Cost increased >12% but latency stable — consider throttling batch size or quant profile
  - Small uptick in fallback model calls — watch for trend across canaries

Communication plan:
  - Slack: #deploys (live), #infra-ops (escalations), #product-alerts (customer-facing impacts)
  - Status page: Sofia to prepare draft messages at each phase; post when canary hits 30% or rollback occurs
  - Customer comms: pre-written email template in linked_artifacts (Sofia will adapt)

Post-deploy checklist (first 6 hours):
  - [ ] Telemetry snapshot + diff uploaded to /artifacts/releases/maestro-oct25
  - [ ] Quick retro notes in this doc (tag: postmortem-needed if rollback or sign-off)
  - [ ] Confirmed no slow burn regressions at 3h and 6h marks

Open questions / TODOs (live):
  - Do we enable the new KV-prefix eviction in canary? (Pros: memory reduce; Cons: cold-start risk) — @Daniel to advise by 10/23 EOD
  - Decide whether to run an extra small batch of A/B prompts to measure coherence drift — Elena owns prompt set
  - Need a short synthetic load script for EU region (current scripts only target us-west) — Marcus to produce by 10/24 08:00 PT

Runbook links / artifacts:
  - Staging smoke script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-scripts/blob/main/smoke.sh
  - Telemetry dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/telemetry/maestro-oct
  - Rollback script: tools/rollback/restore_variant.sh

Notes-to-self style reminders (informal):
  - Keep the canary ramp slow if any tracer shows KV miss storm — those spikes are silent killers
  - If we see small P95 blips at 10% but stable cost, consider changing kernel prefetching rather than rollback
  - Don't forget to set the breeze-mode flag if we need to reduce model quality temporarily for latency (teams tend to avoid it but it's a valid lever)

After-action sketch (post-run; fill in after deployment):
  - Outcome: [GREEN / YELLOW / ROLLBACK] -> (fill)
  - Time to full rollout or rollback: (fill)
  - Notable anomalies: (fill)
  - Action items for next iteration: (fill)

Quick signatures (day-of leads):
  - Deploy Conductor: ____________________
  - Oncall SRE: ____________________
  - Runtime Eng: ____________________
  - Product Eng: ____________________
  - Support Liaison: ____________________

-- end --
